% E2E canonical fixture #5 (optional) — footnotes.
% \footnote*{...} -> \insert\footins path. Pins the footnote separator
% rule (\footnoterule, a 0.4pt = 26214 sp rule) and the footnote text
% landing below the body on the same page ( AC-5/AC-6 regression).
\hsize=4in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\noindent First paragraph before the footnote.\footnote*{A short note.}
\par
\noindent Second paragraph keeps the body non-empty.
\par
\bye
